summary: The canonical format of the RFC Series is changing from plain-text ASCII to XML using the xml2rfc version 3 vocabulary, with other formats rendered from that. This informational document gives the framework that ties together the specifications for the various formats. It was replaced by RFC 9720.

eli5.summary: RFCs used to be plain typed text. They are moving to a richer source from which nice versions are made. This is the big-picture plan. It was replaced by RFC 9720.
